title: Wow Season 7 of Clone Wars so good. Makes me so angry Asohka wasn't Rey's Master. So much lore spat in final trilogy. Do hope Sidiuos takes out Padme
summary: Wow Season 7 of Clone Wars so good. Makes me so angry Asohka wasn't Rey's Master. So much lore spat in final trilogy. Do hope Sidiuos takes out Padme in ep 11 or 12. Padme, warrior Queen, dying of broken heart still worst moment.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Wow Season 7 of Clone Wars so good. Makes me so angry Asohka wasn't Rey's Master. So much lore spat in final trilogy.

Do hope Sidiuos takes out Padme in ep 11 or 12. Padme, warrior Queen, dying of broken heart still worst moment.
